title: Off the Promotion File
setup: Black's rook holds the e-pawn from e1 and the king must hurry back, but only one route survives.
hint: Your rook guards the queening square down the file. Which single step home neither blocks that line nor loses a tempo?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook holds e8 along the file, so the king must not stand on it: {{Ke4}} loses to {{e8=Q+}}, a check that skewers the king to the rook behind it. From d3 or f3, {{Rb7}} gains White the tempo it needs. After {{Kd4}}, {{e8=Q}} {{Rxe8}} leaves only a drawn rook ending.
